title: centralize-rbacv2-decision-telemetry-and-kms-geo-failover
author: Lina Khatri
description:
Motivation: Our RBACv2 decision logic is evaluated across multiple services (policy compiler, gateway, operator shim) but decision telemetry is fragmented. This causes blindspots for compliance audits and makes KMS region-failover behavior hard to reason about during incidents. This PR centralizes RBACv2 decision telemetry into a single, compact schema and adds a KMS geo-failover orchestration module that emits clear audit events when failover occurs. The goal is to provide: 1) a single decision event format for audit ingestion; 2) deterministic sampling and redact rules for PII-sensitive attributes; 3) a configurable KMS geo-failover plan that is visible in audit logs and reversible via operator flags.

What this changes (summary): consolidated decision-logger (src/decision_logger) with v2 schema (src/decision_schema/v2.json); a new failover orchestrator (src/kms_failover/orchestrator.go) that implements per-tenant policy for preferred-region -> fallback-region transitions and emits audit events to the existing audit pipeline; an audit-sampler (pkg/audit/sampler.go) with deterministic sampling keyed by tenant and decision-hash; migration docs and a small Helm patch to opt-in the failover controller via values.rbac.telemetry.enableFailover = true; tests covering policy edge cases and integration smoke tests against the audit pipeline.

Major design notes: - Decision events are intentionally compact: they include a decision_id (UUID), timestamp, policy_revision, principal_claims (whitelisted keys only), outcome (allow/deny/conditional), reason_codes (list), and optional kms_failover_hint when a geo failover is applied. The v2 schema replaces an older verbose format and is backwards-compatible via a lightweight shim in the audit forwarder. - Sampling is deterministic and configurable at the tenancy level to preserve representative coverage while controlling volume. Sampling config keys: rbac.telemetry.defaultSampleRate, rbac.telemetry.tenantOverrides.<tenant_id>. - KMS geo-failover implements a two-phase commit style promotion: check preconditions -> mark intent (audit) -> perform routing change in region-router -> emit final audit event. All steps are idempotent and logged.

Migration & rollout: 1) Deployed as a canary behind a feature flag (rbac.telemetry.enableV2). 2) Start with sample rate 0.01 and increase based on ingestion capacity and audit retention costs. 3) Operator-run migration tool (scripts/migrate_decision_events.sh) migrates retained decision artifacts for historical auditing. 4) Rollback path documented: disable enableV2 and the orchestrator will stop emitting v2 events; the shim preserves ingestion for remaining v1 events.

Testing & CI: Unit tests for decision_logger and kilobyte-level schema validation; integration test that simulates a KMS primary outage and verifies orchestrator logs the intent and final failover event; load test script included under test/load/decision_telemetry_loader.go.

Security/privacy considerations: PII redaction rules in src/decision_logger/redactor.go are conservative by default (drop attributes not on an allowlist). Sampling ensures we don't send full tenant request payloads. KMS failover decisions include only region identifiers and no key material.

Operational runbook snippets: - How to read failover events in the Console: filter audit.kind: "kms.failover" and decision_id. - Emergency revert: set rbac.telemetry.forceDisableFailover=true and run the revert script provided.

Checklist: - [x] Decision schema v2 implemented - [x] Shim to support legacy ingestion - [x] KMS geo-failover orchestrator implemented - [x] Deterministic sampler + tenant overrides - [x] Docs & migration scripts - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Helm/values opt-in

Related: Linear ENG-7319 tracks the telemetry rewrite; ENG-7430 tracks the KMS failover orchestration design. SUP-2026 was opened during a recent support incident that motivated clearer audit traces for region shifts.

release_notes: Centralized RBACv2 decision telemetry (v2 schema) with deterministic sampling and a KMS geo-failover orchestrator. Opt-in via rbac.telemetry.enableV2 and rbac.telemetry.enableFailover. Includes migration scripts and operator runbook. Improves audit clarity for region failover events.
